visual_description: The image shows a large ornate archway with intricate metalwork and decorative elements, topped by a statue. Flanking the arch are tall columns and flagpoles bearing flags. In front of the structure, there is an open plaza with people walking, horse-drawn carriages, and trees. The scene appears historical, possibly from the late 19th or early 20th century. At the bottom left corner, text reads “20 LIBRARY OF CONGRESS MAGAZINE.”
